Showing Understanding for Another Person's Feelings
You use modal verbs must, can't, couldn't and other phrases to show you understand how someone is feeling.

To show you understand how someone feels now use:
You must feel/have/be ...
You can't feel/have/be ...

To show how someone felt earlier use:
You must have felt/had/been ...
You couldn't have felt/had/been ...

Other phrases you can use are:
I can only imagine how you feel/felt.
I know how you feel.
I believe it.
I know you feel/felt ...
I see that you are/feel ...
I can only imagine how you feel.
I see why you are so upset.
Be Supposed To and Be Going To
You use the structure be supposed to and was/were going to when you want to talk about expectations, obligations or arrangements.
You can use be supposed to to talk about situations in the past, present or future.
Subject + to be + supposed to + verb

Present: He is supposed to look into that today.
Past: He was supposed to look into that yesterday.
Future: He is supposed to look into that tomorrow.
You use be going to in the past to talk about something that was expected but did not happen.

Example:
I was going to check out his production plant but I was late.
NOTE : When you say be supposed to, you link the /d/ and /t/ sounds together, like this, be suppose_to
He was supposed to look into that when he began outsourcing labor.
We were supposed to do that.
This whole project wasn't supposed to be so arduous.
I'm not supposed to mix personal and professional life.
I can't believe I was going to profit from partnering with a company that used children.
Example: If the phone rings, could you take the call for me?
These are words you use to talk about jobs and work.
to be in a position to
to be able to do something
Example: I'm not in a position to say if he was fully aware.
Example: I don't know if he was fully aware of the consequences.
Example: I was going to check out his production plant but I was late.
to imagine or expect that something will happen
Example: You couldn't have anticipated this.
Example: This whole project wasn't supposed to be so arduous.
to open a discussion about something
to ​support a ​person, ​organization, or ​activity by giving ​money, ​encouragement, or other ​help
Example: I sponsor five children in that city.
Example: I can't believe I was going to profit from partnering with a company that used children I'm trying to help.
to be encouraged to do something
Example: You have the incentive to make change.
Think of 5 situations that would cause you to feel some emotion, either positive or negative.
Write down your 5 ideas using 2 or 3 sentences to describe each situation.
Read your first situation to your partner and let them react and show that they understand how you feel.
Listen to your partner's situation and express that you understand how he or she feels.
Take turns reading your situations until you have read all 5.

Miranda : Janet, is everything ok?
Janet : Not really. If the phone rings, could you take the call for me?
Miranda : Ok. One of those days, huh?
Janet : Yeah ... Miranda, the rumor's true. Farmani's factory employs children!
Miranda : Oh my ... You must be shocked! Is Farmani aware of this?
Janet : I'm not in a position to say if he was fully aware, but he was supposed to look into that when he began outsourcing labor. I was going to check out his production plant but I was late.

Miranda : You couldn't have anticipated this. I know that we were supposed to do that, but we had a difficult deadline and research was going to come later.
Janet : Miranda, I'm afraid I'm finished.
Miranda : What? Janet, I can only imagine how you feel.
Janet : I don't know what to do. This whole project wasn't supposed to be so arduous.
Miranda : I know you feel terrible but we can make an approach to Farmani.

Janet : It's more personal. I sponsor five children in that city. I know I'm not supposed to mix personal and professional life. I can't believe I was going to profit from partnering with a company that used children I'm trying to help.
Miranda : Now I see why you are so upset. But Janet, you can help them! Maybe Farmani ...
Janet : Farmani only cares about its reputation.
Miranda : I believe it. And that's why I'm convinced that you're supposed to do the job. You have the incentive to make a change.
